steps.content: The defeated dark hands turn into broken sculptures and fall onto the ground.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Huh? This is weird...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yes?
Hella turns around and finds EMP crouching on the ground, fiddling with the plaster pieces.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey! When did you become a scavenger?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Enough of your trash talk. Come and check this out.
EMP rolls her eyes and points to the broken pieces.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh... It's just pieces left by those monsters. What's there to see?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Take a closer look!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ah... Huh? They are in a different shape?!
That's when the navigator starts to talk again.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: The sculpture is called <color=#fb9259>Abyss</color> and has the shape of a teenager being dragged into the abyss by thirteen hands. I intended to satirize those who think ignorance is bliss and therefore hurt themselves.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: The abyss is not a place you can return from. People who blindly pursue thrill, sneer at or even toy with danger and the unknown, will eventually be swallowed. It's their deserved retribution.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Things here do seem distorted for some reason...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Is it some kind of spiritual contamination? They cover the works and create illusions to confuse the intruders?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ahhh... You need to stop all the wicked talk now. It's giving me chills...
Wrong! Can't be further from... Ouch!
A curly-haired man strides out from behind a statue. He tries to strike a cool pose but slips and falls on his face.
But he quickly rises from the ground covered by broken glass and plaster, and continues to talk excitedly.

This is the hunting ground of various horrific monsters from urban legends. Anyone who enters here will be devoured, which is why they never return. Now that is a story worthy of the spooky atmosphere of Witching Hour!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Huh? Then the Chief...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Bah! What are you trying to say?! There's no way the Chief was eaten by these things!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: And more importantly...
Hella raises her pipe and points at the stranger.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Who are you?

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: Ahaha, I'm <color=#fb9259>Josh</color>, the famous ur... um, a staff member of the art museum.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The famous... staff?

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: Yeah. Is there something wrong with that?
The guy claiming to be Josh says this while flicking his work permit that was flung behind his back to the front.

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: If I'm not mistaken, you two are FAC agents sent here to investigate the case, right? You are super lucky to have run into me today.

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: I know this museum better than my own home. Even with my eyes closed, I can lead you guys out. Hah, I'm in a good mood today, so I will be kind and let you two tag along.

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: What are you waiting for? Come on! You can even witness my heroic adventure. It's now or never!
He struts forward arrogantly while not forgetting to let out a loud, unpleasant, gargling laugh.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Nut case...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: He doesn't look very reliable, but he works here. And he said he knows the way. How about we... follow him?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why are you not moving?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: You aren't moving, either.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why should I lead the way? Are you afraid?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Huh, Why would I be afraid? You'd be pissing your pants, and I wouldn't be afraid!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Then why are you talking nonsense instead of walking?! He'll be long gone if we don't keep up!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Talking nonsense? Me? You're the one who keeps blabbering...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Forget it. There's no point in arguing with you! I'm going. Who's scared now?
